text:
Ana Lopez: Heads up — playbook runner started spamming duplicate owner claims this morning, causing healthscore to dip for ~1.2k accounts. Noticed after 03:10 deploy. Anyone seeing related alerts? playbook-id: owner-claim-v2
Ben Cho: Seeing same. Alert: csops-healthscore-spike. Looks like dedupe step isn't gating on email_verified. Possibly schema change from last ETL.
Carla Méndez: Adding logs from last run:
```
INFO 2026-03-23T03:12:22Z owner-claim-v2: evaluated 1203 accounts
WARN missing_field: email_verified null for 312 accounts
ERROR reconciliation: duplicate claim prevented: false
```
Jamal Khan: @Ana @Ben re-synced connector, but mapping still returns legacy.contact.email_verified as string 'true'/'false'. We need cast->boolean before playbook condition. Pushing patch to connectors repo.
Ana Lopez: Good catch. Can playbook runner be patched to tolerate string booleans? If not, we should add a temporary gating rule to skip if email_verified is null or not boolean.
playbook-bot: patch recommended: add precondition `type(email_verified) == boolean` to rule `owner-claim` ; refer runbook https://rwd.infra/runbooks/playbooks/owner-claim
Ben Cho: Quick fix proposal (in Slack):
```
preconditions:
  - key: email_verified
    op: exists
  - key: email_verified
    op: type_is
    value: boolean
```
Carla Méndez: Will also run a dry-run with sample 5% to confirm no regression. ETA 30m.
Jamal Khan: Patch submitted -> PR 4821. CC @Ana for canary approval.
Ana Lopez: Approving canary once dry-run looks clean. Also need to flag affected accounts for manual review: export list to #cs-manual-review. Use query:
```
SELECT account_id, owner_id, health_score
FROM accounts
WHERE last_playbook = 'owner-claim-v2' AND email_verified IS NULL
LIMIT 5000
```
playbook-bot: scheduled canary rollout at +10% if dry-run pass. :white_check_mark: 
Ben Cho: After patch, re-run healthscore recalculation for those accounts using `healthscore.recalc(affected_ids)`
Carla Méndez: started dry-run at 03:42.
Ana Lopez: TY all. Follow up: add schema validation to connector CI and create a postmortem ticket CSOPS-136 to track root cause & ops playbook change. I'll own follow-up. :memo:
Jamal Khan: I'll include the connector schema test in the PR.
Carla Méndez: Dry-run shows no duplicate claims on 5% sample. Moving to canary.
Ben Cho: Canary +10% started 03:58. Monitoring token billing & error logs.
Ana Lopez: Last check-in — no spikes, healthscore trend stabilizing. Closing thread but keeping ticket open for next week review. :slightly_smiling_face:
